comment: He started giving weird assignments that had little to no instruction. After emailing him and asking him questions, he never answered the questions I would ask. If he would just explain the assignments a little bit more then it would be easier. The TA is also down horrendous, like boi I never see you in class, and you're not very reasonable.

The best professor I have had at UR. I wish he would teach some of what he does in the classroom to others here. Hands down the most caring professor you could have. The group project was amazing and I learned so much from running experiments.

Rude and disrespectful. Tries to be hard on students but is just mean to groups he doesn't like. Course content is basically common sense, won't get much out of it unless you're actually trying to start a business or a non b school kid.

Learning from failure is rewarded in this class. Why do other classes grades failure harshly? This was my first entrepreneurship class and we were encouraged to try new thing without fear of failure. I wish all classes did this.

Prof. Courtney posts video lectures online which leaves time for him to provide feedback to students on their team project in class. Given the social distancing in the classroom, I find it easier to listen to lectures on my own time. He is always available. On the downside, it has been difficult to hear other students in the class.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!!!!!! One of the most USELESS classes I have ever taken. He is so confusing, has instructions in like 10 different folders so things are always jumbled, teaches in a confusing way, grades in a confusing way (never uses a 100 scale) so I have no idea what grade I have in the class and I'm over halfway into the semester.

The worst professor I have ever had. I would say I am a good student and enjoy my classes normally but CC is simply the worst. If I wasn't so far in the entrepreneurship minor, I would've dropped the class and the minor because I have never hated a class and a professor this much. Do not take his class. You will regret it. He's so bland.

I took Prof Courtney's class because I was really excited to take a cool class, and i was interested in minoring in entrepreneurship. He made me hate entrepreneurship and now I am no longer minoring in it. Class is SO boring and you do so much unnecessary homework. Courtney does not teach at all, his projects are so time consuming. 0/10.

Professor Courtney makes the class fun and engaging. This is the first class I have taken where the professor let's you select your own grade components. I wish more would do this. The team project was a great learning experience.

I had no clue what strategy was when I started. Professor Courtney provides real-world examples that help me understand the content. He goes above and beyond when meeting with him. It is clear from day one that he cares about his students. This is the best class I have taken here. I learned so much from the group project.
Learned a lot in this class. Chris cares about how you do in the real world. He wrote a letter of recommendation for me.
I was not sure what I would learn when I started the class. I had an interview recently and discovered how valuable the class is. So glad I took this class after nailing the interview.

I learned a lot from the case studies. Most of the learning came from hearing other students during the discussion. I came to his office to discuss a business idea and was blown away by his helpful advice. Good text book and slides. If you participate in class it's easy to get an A.

Professor Courtney needs to understand that most of the students took this class not because they love Strategic Management, but because they have to. Also, he needs to understand that he has to respect his students and communicate with them, instead of giving inexplicable comments at the end of the semester.
